records.subject: Mixing desert sand grains with aqueous Cu(NO3)2 electrolyte
records.quote: In this paper, new TGCs are reported, and they are made of desert sand grains mixed with the Cu(NO3)2 aqueous electrolyte, named as QS-Cu-TGCs, the thermoelectric performance of which is investigated.
modality_evidence: In this paper, new TGCs are reported, and they are made of desert sand grains mixed with the Cu(NO3)2 aqueous electrolyte, named as QS-Cu-TGCs, the thermoelectric performance of which is investigated.

records.subject: QS-Cu-TGCs
records.quote: It is found that although sand grains are common, widely seen in the desert, the Carnot efficiency of such N-type QS-Cu-TGCs is quite high, about 4%, with the Seebeck coefficient of 8.4 mV K-1, driven by the temperature difference 12.1 K between two electrodes, in an environment below 373 K.
